title: Add RAG tool-bound workflow quickstart with stubbed agent runtime
author: Asha Kapoor
release_notes: New quickstart: a minimal, tool-bound RAG authoring sandbox with a stubbed agent runtime, structured-output contracts, and smoke CI for local validation.
description: Motivation: provide a small, battery-included quickstart for teams authoring retrieval-augmented tool-calling agents that need fast local feedback loops. This quickstart packages: 1) a tiny stubbed agent runtime (TypeScript) that runs locally and exposes a tool-binding API; 2) a set of contract-first tool schemas and structured-output validators; 3) an incremental index + mocked retriever that can be swapped for a real vector DB; 4) telemetry probe scaffolds and a smoke test harness for CI. The goal is to let engineers iterate on tool contracts and prompt/tool orchestration without provisioning full infra or real connectors. What this PR changes: - Adds quickstarts/toolbound-agent/README.md with step-by-step authoring, troubleshooting, and intended learning objectives. - Adds an opinionated example agent at quickstarts/toolbound-agent/examples/agent.ts demonstrating tool discovery, deterministic replay, and partial-response resume. - Adds a compact mock retriever and incremental indexer (quickstarts/toolbound-agent/lib/indexer.ts) and a CLI (dev/runner.ts) to run scenarios offline. - Adds structured output schema examples (schemas/tool-contracts.json) with a lightweight validator and linter integration. - Adds CI smoke pipeline config (.github/workflows/quickstart-ci.yml) that runs headless scenario replay and the structured-output linter. - Adds telemetry probe presets (telemetry/probes.yaml) and docs page (docs/rag-toolbound.md) describing recommended metrics and alert thresholds. Tests and verification: ran the local runner across three seed scenarios (happy path, tool-misuse, partial response resume) and exercised the structured-output linter. CI: all checks pass in the quickstart pipeline (smoke tests + linter). Checklist: - [x] Quickstart README with usage and learning objectives - [x] Example agent demonstrating tool-binding and structured-output - [x] Mock retriever and incremental index for offline iteration - [x] Structured-output schema + lint integration - [x] CI smoke workflow for reproducible validation - [x] Telemetry probe presets and docs link Testing notes and tips: runner seeds are intentionally small (≤ 3 documents) to keep latency low. To integrate with a real index swap the 'MockRetriever' in examples/agent.ts; instructions included in README. Related work: this quickstart is intentionally narrower than the full RAG Playbook quickstarts — it complements the existing RAG templates by focusing on contract-first tool-binding authoring and offline validation. Linked Linear: ENG-4232 (authoring DX), PM-987 (quickstart intake). Merge: Squash-merged after two rounds of review and one CI re-run. Known limitations: no cloud indexer included; the runner is not production-grade and is intended for authoring/eval only. Future work: add a Rust/WASM minimal runner and a Python adapter for teams who prefer those stacks.
